title: Single-beam analysis pipeline

independentValidation.method: live serialized comparison with the pinned JavaScript source plus closed-form and contract-level single-beam checks
parityFixtures: simply supported beam under a uniform load with source-compatible reaction, moment, and deflection checks
inclined beam with default horizontal load projection
non-zero section rotation with projected rigidity, principal actions, and warning parity
G1, G2, and multiple Qk load-case combination factors
ULS and SLE combination envelopes and result selection
user, verification-grid, combined, and all station selection
beam section action verification through the solver-neutral contract
torsional action forwarding and requested-station filtering
rigid composite section stiffness and custom provider metadata
exact full-result comparison against the pinned JavaScript SingleBeamAnalysis

parityDifferences: No numerical, serialized DTO, unit-conversion, ordering, envelope, warning, or tested error-behavior difference is known for this slice.
The JavaScript source remains the canonical runtime implementation; this TypeScript boundary adds strict compile-time contracts without changing the runtime public subset.
singleBeamDesignApplication.test.js is retained as a source oracle only. Its downstream design/report application is outside this generic domain slice and is not claimed as migrated.
engineeringFunctionality: Usable solver-neutral analysis of a straight beam with explicit section or provider stiffness, Euler–Bernoulli or Timoshenko linear elements, inclined geometry, section rotation projection, supports, uniform and point loads, load cases, combinations, governing contexts, selectable result stations, sampled internal forces and reactions, envelopes, and generic beam-section action verification. This slice does not provide RC foundation-beam verification, foundation-beam soil interaction, cracked-section deflection, building-level analysis, or solver-specific adapters.
